name: Apple Fritter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Apple Fritter is a balanced hybrid strain that embodies the tasty pastry of the same name with its deep-fried dough filled with apples and cinnamon. This strain has an almost identical flavor profile of sweet and fruity apples with mild earthy notes.
